bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Bieu do tuong tac

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den vung > Insert > Chart (Column/Line/Pie) hoac Recommended Charts
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon vung du lieu roi chon loai bieu do. Recommended goi y theo du lieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den Ten NV + Doanh thu > Insert > Column ngang > OK

cong_thuc.ten: Tieu de bieu do lien ket o
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click tieu de > Formula Bar go = > click o C5 > Enter
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tieu de lay dong tu o; doi o thi tieu de doi theo. Hoac boi den go tay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tieu de =C5; C5='Loi nhuan' thi tieu de doi thanh Loi nhuan

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Double-click truc ten > Format Axis > Axis Options > Categories in reverse order
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dao thu tu hien thi (GX5->GX1 thanh GX1->GX5). Phim tat Ctrl+1 mo Format.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Truc dang GX5..GX1 > tich Reverse thanh GX1..GX5

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click 1 lan chon all > click lan 2 chon 1 cot > chuot phai > Add Data Label
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Click 1 chon ca chuoi, click 2 chon diem rieng. Add Data Label hien so.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon cot GX3 > Add Data Label hien 24; click so 24 + Delete de xoa

cong_thuc.ten: Hien gia tri toan bo + dinh dang vi tri/mau
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click 1 diem > chuot phai > Add Data Labels > Format Data Labels (Ctrl+1): Inside Base/Outside End, mau trang + dam
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien het gia tri; Center/Inside End/Inside Base/Outside End chinh vi tri; to mau cho de doc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Add all labels > Inside Base + trang + dam; xoa Gridlines doc cho dep

cong_thuc.ten: Chart Elements (+), Data Table, Gridlines, Legend
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click bieu do > nut + > tich Axis Titles/Data Table/Gridlines/Legend/Trendline
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nut + them/bot thanh phan. Data Table hien bang so duoi chart; Legend giai thich mau.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bat Legend Top de biet xanh=Doanh thu, vang=Ke hoach; tat Gridlines cho gon

cong_thuc.ten: Ve bieu do tu o trong (Select Data)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click o trong > Insert chart > Design > Select Data > Add Series (name+values) + Edit Axis Labels
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Khi chart trang, tu nap du lieu: Add Series Name + Values, Edit truc = vung ten NV. Cach nhanh: Chart Data Range = toan vung.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Add Series Name=Doanh thu, Values=C2:C6; Edit Labels=A2:A6; hoac Range=A1:C6

cong_thuc.ten: Them Ke hoach vao chart (2 cach)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: C1: keo goc vung xanh sang phai | C2: Select Data > Add Series Ke hoach
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Keo bien vung nguon de them cot Ke hoach; hoac Add series moi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Keo tu Doanh thu sang Ke hoach -> 2 mau; Legend Top phan biet

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai bieu do > Cut (hoac click vien + Delete)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon ca bieu do roi Cut/Delete.

cong_thuc.ten: Bieu do tuong tac Chon Quy (bai 18/19)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: =IF(OR($C$2='ON',$C$2=C$4),'Du lieu'!C3,'') + Validation List: ON,Quy1..Quy4 + cong phu E1='Doanh thu '&IF($C$2='ON','ca nam',$C$2)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dropdown C2 chon ON/Quy; IF+OR loc: neu ON hoac trung tieu de Quy thi lay so lieu tu sheet Du lieu, nguoc lai rong. Keo cong thuc khap bang + ve chart + Tong = ten & CHAR(10) & SUM.
cong_thuc.vi_du: C2=Quy1 chi hien cot Quy1; C2=ON hien ca nam; tieu de chart =E1 tu doi

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cot % rat nho (<1) so voi Ke hoach/Thuc hien nen phai ve truc phu; Home > Percent hoac Ctrl+1 > Percentage.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Thuc hien 70 / Ke hoach 100 = 70%; keo chart range sang cot % se thay cot be tit duoi truc

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click series % > Format Data Series > Series Options > Secondary Axis
cong_thuc.giai_thich: % hien o truc phai, Ke hoach/Thuc hien o truc trai. Chon series qua Chart Options dropdown neu kho click.
cong_thuc.vi_du: % hoan thanh chuyen sang truc phai; doi chart type Line cho series %

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai series > Change Series Chart Type > Combo (Column + Line); Format > Gap Width %; Line: No line + Marker Built-in size 10
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ke hoach doi sang Line (Excel 2016+), doanh thu giu Column; Gap Width co gian khoang cach cot; No line + marker gach ngang hien Ke hoach dep.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ke hoach: Line, No line, Marker gach ngang size 10; Gap Width nho lai cot to ra

cong_thuc.giai_thich: CHAR(10) la ky tu xuong dong; bat Wrap Text de hien 2 dong: ten + tong (vd GX1 + 57). Dung lam Axis Label qua Select Data > Edit.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Total GX2 = 163; Edit Horizontal Labels = vung Total moi; chart cot chong hien tong + chi tiet quy

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Ctrl+1 > Number > Custom: #.00% hoac #% ; Data Label Position: Above / Inside Base
cong_thuc.giai_thich: #.00% giu 2 thap phan (67.25%), #% gon (67%). Label % de Above, label cot de Inside Base, mau den/automatic.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Format Data Labels > Number > #.00% > Add; khong thich thi doi ve #% cho dep

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Ve bieu do cot tu vung du lieu
cac_buoc: Boi den Ten NV + Doanh thu
Insert > Column/Bar/Line/Pie hoac Recommended Charts
Chon kieu (vd cot ngang) > OK
Sua tieu de (go tay hoac =C5 lien ket)

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Dao thu tu truc + hien Data Label
cac_buoc: Double-click truc ten (hoac Ctrl+1) > tich Categories in reverse order
Click 1 lan chon chuoi > click lan 2 chon cot GX3 > Add Data Label
Muon hien all: click 1 diem > Add Data Labels cho ca chuoi
Format label: Inside Base, mau trang, dam; xoa Gridlines neu muon

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Tuy chinh Chart Elements va Legend
cac_buoc: Click bieu do > nut +
Bat/tat Axis Titles, Data Table, Gridlines, Legend
Dat Legend Top va keo ra goc cho dep
Xoa chart: chuot phai > Cut

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Ve chart tu o trong bang Select Data
cac_buoc: Click o trong > Insert > chart (se trang)
Design > Select Data > Add: Name=Doanh thu, Values=vung doanh thu
Edit Horizontal Labels = vung ten NV > OK > OK
Hoac nhap Chart Data Range = toan vung A1:C6

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Them Ke hoach + lam bieu do tuong tac Quy
cac_buoc: Them cot Ke hoach (12,35,29,15,20)
C1: click chart keo bien xanh sang Ke hoach; C2: Select Data > Add series Ke hoach
Legend Top/Bottom, doi mau Fill tuy y; Design > Quick Layout/Change Colors
Combo: chuot phai Ke hoach > Change Series Chart Type > Line (Excel 2016+); No line + Marker Built-in size 10
Gap Width: double-click cot (Ctrl+1) > keo Gap Width nho lai cho cot to ra
Cot %: them cot =Thuc hien/Ke hoach, Format Percent; dua vao chart roi chuyen Secondary Axis
Total label: =Ten & CHAR(10) & SUM(4 quy), Wrap Text; Select Data > Edit Labels = vung Total
Bai tuong tac: sheet Loi giai copy du lieu; C2 Validation List ON,Quy1-4 (ten khop tieu de)
O C3: =IF(OR($C$2='ON',$C$2=C$4),'Du lieu'!C3,'') voi $C$2 co dinh, C$4 co dinh dong; keo khap bang
O phu E1='Doanh thu '&IF(C2='ON','ca nam',C2); chart title =E1 (trang); Tong = ten & CHAR(10) & SUM; Select Data gan lai ten; ve chart chong cot
